units.source_text: 到汤野，要沿着河津川的山涧下行十多公里。

en.t: To reach Yunogano, one had to follow the ravine of the Kawazu River downhill for more than ten kilometers.

units.source_text: 翻过山岭，连山峦和苍穹的色彩也是一派南国的风光。

en.t: Once we crossed the mountain ridge, even the colors of the mountains and the vast sky had the look of the south.

units.source_text: 我和那汉子不住地倾心畅谈，亲密无间。

en.t: The man and I kept talking openly from the heart, growing completely at ease with each other.

units.source_text: 过了荻乘、梨本等寒村小庄，山脚下汤野的草屋顶便跳入了眼帘。

en.t: After passing cold little villages and hamlets such as Oginori and Nashimoto, the thatched roofs of Yunogano at the foot of the mountain suddenly came into view.

units.source_text: 我断然说出要同她们一起旅行到下田。

en.t: I firmly declared that I would travel together with them as far as Shimoda.
The man was delighted beyond expectation.
